notes:
Old film repairs now work on Max quality, and you can just ask for them.

Ticking Remove dust & blotches or Steady the brightness with Max quality selected used to do nothing at all — the controls were there, the render ran, and the dirt came back untouched. They now apply on every preset.

You can also just type it: 'remove the dust and specks', 'fix the flickering', 'steady the brightness'. Those phrasings previously answered 'I didn't catch an edit in that' for a feature that was already working.

Also fixed: 'give my industrial video a warmer look' planned a full GPU upscale instead of a colour grade, because 'industrial' contains the letters of 'dust'.
